Bug_Title: "@SpringBootApplication" and "@ComponentScan" should not be used in the default package
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by keeping the comments indicating the misuse of @SpringBootApplication and @ComponentScan in the default package, even though these annotations are not actually used due to the removal of unnecessary imports and the absence of Spring Boot related code.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case triggers the bug by including a comment indicating the misuse of @SpringBootApplication and @ComponentScan in the default package within the test method. Although the annotations are not actually present in the code, the presence of the comment in the context of the test method is intended to demonstrate the violation of the rule.
